acceptance.check: INV-FO-SURVEYED (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): dimension or capacity without surveyed/drawn basis — a value off a drawing is not the same number
INV-FO-LEADTIME (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): lead time without from-order/from-approval basis, or without confirmed/indicative flag
INV-FO-FIRE-ASSEMBLY (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): fire rating without its tested assembly — a product sheet is not an assembly test
INV-FO-AREA-BASIS (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): floor area without basis (GEA/GIA/NIA/IPMS/local GFA) — same building, several correct answers
INV-FO-REVISION (currency at H3, severity refuse): figure from a superseded drawing revision
INV-FO-PROVENANCE (provenance at H3, severity refuse): rate or lead time carried from a previous project or order
INV-FO-SCOPE (scope at H0, severity refuse): requires a named authority — refer to {authority}
INV-FO-CAPACITY-CURRENCY (currency at H3, severity refuse): spare capacity is stale the moment another tenant takes it
INV-FO-LEADTIME-CURRENCY (currency at H3, severity refuse): a confirmed lead time lapses; a lapsed confirmation is an indicative quote
INV-FO-RATING-CURRENCY (currency at H3, severity refuse): a fire rating is stale after any design change to the assembly
INV-FO-RATE-CURRENCY (currency at H3, severity refuse): a rate is stale on market or currency movement

author: Cerebrum Team
description: Declarative fitout reasoning kit on the shared reasoning layer. 11 invariants declared in app/blocks/fitout/invariants.yaml across the kinds the portable spec defines (grounding, qualifier, unit_discipline, authority, provenance, currency, scope, derivation, band) and the five hooks (H0 pre-retrieval, H1 ranking, H2 tool-time, H3 answer-time, H4 export-time). Vocabulary in app/blocks/fitout/manifest.yaml. Scope refusals classify BEFORE retrieval. Fail closed: a kit that does not parse is DISABLED and refuses every statement rather than passing them through with no invariants. NO INTERVIEW HAS RUN, so every declared figure value is null and the block refuses rather than inventing one (app/blocks/fitout/KNOWN_GAPS.md). Measured by tests/blocks/test_reasoning_kits.py.

inputs.description: the operator question, classified at H0 BEFORE any retrieval
inputs.name: question

inputs.description: figures to gate: quantity, value, unit, origin, source_id, source_class, revision, qualifiers, claim_class, derivations, conditions, steps, bounds, asked_about, span, text
inputs.name: figures

inputs.description: state records by provider name, each {as_of: Unix time in seconds}; a record with no as_of, or older than its provider's max_age, is reported stale; an absent provider yields UNKNOWN, never a design-basis fallback
inputs.name: state

inputs.description: events that have happened, matched against the kit's staleness_triggers
inputs.name: events

inputs.description: subset of H0..H4 to run; all five by default, because a partial sweep is a silent coverage gap
inputs.name: hooks

name: fitout_kit

outputs.description: pass | annotated | flagged | refused, with findings, blocked_reason, hooks_run, retrieval_permitted, interview_status, unfilled_figures, unmeasured_invariants, ships and kit_disabled
outputs.name: verdict
